name: FUN_SENSOR_INSTANCE_TASKS
description: The table stores the sensor instance task details. Eg: BusinessCriteriaResolverTask, ActionHandlerTask etc.

columns.name: INSTANCE_TASK_ID
columns.description: Primary identifier to identify Instance task uniquely - Database sequence

columns.name: INSTANCE_ID
columns.description: Maps to an instance in the FUN_SENSOR_INSTANCES table.

columns.name: PARENT_INSTANCE_TASK_ID
columns.description: The tasks defined in the sensor formula captures the dependency starting with 0 (root), then in level order hierarchy of 1 and so on. This column captures that sequence of dependency.

columns.name: TASK_NAME
columns.description: Name of the executable task for an instance.

columns.name: REQUEST_PAYLOAD
columns.description: JSON Request payload sent to Business Criteria Resolver for evaluation

columns.name: RESPONSE_PAYLOAD
columns.description: JSON Response payload received from Business Criteria Resolver after evaluation

columns.name: RETRY_COUNT
columns.description: To store the Failure retry count

columns.name: NEXT_RETRY_TIME
columns.description: Captures the the next retry time

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
